title: OSWorld interaction loop
snippet:
load task config and VM state
observe screenshot + a11y tree + streams
propose executable action
execute in environment
run evaluation or continue until terminate

title: AgentTrek tutorial-to-trajectory pipeline
snippet:
collect GUI tutorials from the web
classify and paraphrase task structure
replay guidance in target environment
synthesize trajectories and reasoning traces

title: Synthetic CoTA generation
snippet:
sample multimodal task
generate thought-and-action trace
filter useless actions
finetune multimodal action model on CoTA data

title: AGUVIS two-stage training
snippet:
stage 1: train GUI grounding on large-scale visual targets
stage 2: train planning and reasoning with trajectories and inner monologue
deploy unified pure-vision policy across platforms

title: Generative frame sampler
snippet:
encode long video context
condition on user instruction
generate relevant frame spans with confidence scores
forward selected frames to downstream long-video QA or grounding model
